T1 has added two-time Masters champion Tyson 'TenZ' Ngo to its Valorant roster for VCT Pacific in 2027. The move ends his retirement and builds on T1's signing of crashies, who has just left London-based Fnatic.

item.title: Reinstated Aurora Gaming beat F9 EICAR to win Valorant Europe Qualifier 1
item.description:
Aurora Gaming came from a map down to beat F9 EICAR 2-1 and win the first VCT EMEA Kickoff Europe open qualifier. The win came days after they were put back into the bracket when the UK team BONK was disqualified for cheating.

item.description:
The MongolZ beat world No.1 FURIA to reach the IEM Beijing semi-finals, while NAVI eliminated big-spending Falcons in the group stage. The results reshape the picture of the main contenders before the PGL Major Singapore opens on 24 November.

item.title: Gen.G sweep LYON to end North America’s Worlds 2026 run and set up iG semi-final
item.description:
Gen.G beat LYON 3-0 in Allen, Texas, removing North America's last team from Worlds 2026. The LCK top seed are now one series from a first Worlds final, with a revived Invictus Gaming in the way.

The post Gen.G sweep LYON to end North America’s Worlds 2026 run and set up iG semi-final appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: Invictus Gaming beat Top Esports 3-1 to reach first Worlds semi-final since 2019
item.description:
Invictus Gaming knocked out fellow LPL side Top Esports in the opening quarter-final of Worlds 2026 in Allen, Texas. The result guarantees China a semi-final place after the LPL's 0-4 start in the Swiss Stage.
